messages:
Nina: Quick kickoff for benchmark launch SEO tasks. Need keywords, JSON-LD, redirects for legacy/beta paths, internal link plan, and webinar UTMs. Can we divide?
Sam: Ill do keyword mapping for landing, webinar, benchmarks hub. Propose 2 focussed keywords per page.
Priya: Ill handle schema + meta titles/descriptions. Will validate with Rich Results.
Jon: I can implement redirects and add a redirect-check endpoint for QA. Share legacy paths.
Ravi: Ill own UTMs and analytics mapping. Recommend utm_campaign=bench_launch_q2, utm_source=org-email, utm_medium=email.
Sam: Draft redirect lines (to be reviewed): /beta/bench -> /benchmarks/2026 301, /old-bench -> /benchmarks 301, /events/bench-2025 -> /webinars/bench-launch 301.
Priya: JSON-LD draft for Event to paste in head: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Benchmark Launch","startDate":"2026-04-05T16:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.com/webinars/bench-launch"}}
Jon: Ill add nginx rewrite rules and a wildcard for legacy subdomain. Will open PR with redirects.txt and smoke test route.
Ravi: Adding GA4 conversion for webinar signup, and server-side logging for 301s. Will add tracking to redirect PR.
Nina: Owners: Sam=keywords+redirect list, Priya=meta+schema, Jon=redirects+deploy, Ravi=UTMs+analytics. Aim for PRs by Thursday EOD, deploy Friday AM.
Priya: Will keep meta titles under 60 chars and provide 2 description variants for A/B.
Sam: Internal linking suggestions: /docs/perf-tuning -> landing, /pricing/dedicated -> pricing CTA, /benchmarks -> hub. Will CSV and attach to PR.
Jon: PR link when ready, I'll ask SRE for quick review label.
Nina: Thanks all. Friday 10am smoke test and analytics check.
